# Footprint

<!-- GENERATED by `make generate` from src/catalog: DO NOT EDIT -->

Everything `station` and the catalogue's tools write on a machine, by level. The levels, the relocation rule and the commands that clean and reset are [Storage](storage.md)'s.

| Level  | Who removes it                                      |
| ------ | --------------------------------------------------- |
| cache  | `station storage clean`, with no question           |
| data   | `station storage reset <tool>`, named and confirmed |
| config | nobody: a config item's uninstall where reversible  |
| kept   | nobody                                              |

Paths under `~/.config`, `~/.local/share`, `~/.local/state` and `~/.cache` follow their `XDG_*_HOME` variable when it is set and absolute. A path marked mac lives on a host and a macOS VM; linux, on a Linux VM; vm, in every VM and never on a host; host, on a host only.

## Station

| Path                                                       | Level     | Note                                                                               |
| ---------------------------------------------------------- | --------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `~/.cache/station/*`                                       | cache     | downloaded station binaries (`station-linux-arm64`)                                |
| `~/.local/state/station/logs/*.log`                        | cache     | `daemon.log`, each VM's run `<vm>.log`, `station-build-<image>.log`, `setup.log`   |
| `~/.local/state/station/images/askpass`                    | cache     | 0700, the base image's admin password during a build                               |
| `~/.local/state/station/dns/quad9-dns.mobileconfig`        | cache     | regenerated by the dns item                                                        |
| `~/.local/share/station/vms/vms/*`                         | data      | station's VMs and images: `station machines delete`, `station images delete`       |
| `~/.local/state/station/images/*/*.json`                   | data      | image records, paired with their images                                            |
| `~/.local/state/station/known_hosts/*`                     | data      | pins: deleting them downgrades to trust-on-first-use, never cleaned                |
| `~/.local/state/station/consoles/*`                        | data      | live while a VM or a build runs: `consoles/<vm>`, `consoles/station-build-<image>` |
| `~/.local/state/station/daemon.sock`                       | data      | the daemon's socket, live while it runs                                            |
| `~/.local/state/station/runs/*`                            | data      | each running VM's `<vm>.pid` and `<vm>.exit`                                       |
| `~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.jterrazz.station.daemon.plist` | config    | host; the one daemon's launchd agent                                               |
| `~/.config/station/settings.json`                          | config    | here, hosts, vm_user, the lend list, the services policy                           |
| `~/.config/station/services.env`                           | config    | vm; its profiles' exports, written by the guest                                    |
| `~/.local/state/station/guest.json`                        | data      | vm; the host that runs it                                                          |
| `~/.local/state/station/guest.sock`                        | data      | vm; the guest's socket, live while it runs                                         |
| `~/.zshrc`                                                 | config    | the one managed block                                                              |
| `~/.ssh/config`                                            | config    | one Host block per fleet machine                                                   |
| `~/.local/state/station/vms/*.json`                        | kept      | VM records: do not delete                                                          |
| `~/.local/state/station/images/key*`                       | kept      | the only way into a fresh VM: do not delete                                        |
| `~/.local/state/station/leases.json`                       | kept      | the services' host ports: deleting it changes every URL                            |
| `~/.local/bin/station`                                     | installed | removed by `station tools uninstall`                                               |

The keychain service `station` holds nothing since round 5: `station setup` removed the three tailnet accounts the earlier rounds kept there. It also retired round 3's per-VM launchd agents, `~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.jterrazz.station.vm.*.plist`: booted out and removed, the one daemon runs every VM.

## Home-root exceptions

What a tool keeps at the root of the home folder, declared with its reason; anything else there is a stray.

| Path               | Reason                                                                |
| ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `~/.ssh`           | the owner's keys and ssh config                                       |
| `~/.gnupg`         | the owner's GPG keys                                                  |
| `~/.cargo`         | rust-analyzer started by a GUI IDE would lose the toolchain           |
| `~/.rustup`        | rust-analyzer started by a GUI IDE would lose the toolchain           |
| `~/.claude`        | Claude Code reads no config file for its home                         |
| `~/.codex`         | Codex reads no config file for its home                               |
| `~/.zshrc`         | a dotfile                                                             |
| `~/.npmrc`         | a dotfile: npm's own config                                           |
| `~/.gitconfig`     | a dotfile                                                             |
| `~/.bunfig.toml`   | a dotfile: bun's global config                                        |
| `~/.tmux.conf`     | a dotfile                                                             |
| `~/.hushlogin`     | a dotfile                                                             |
| `~/.claude.json`   | a dotfile                                                             |
| `~/.zsh_history`   | a dotfile                                                             |
| `~/.zcompdump*`    | a dotfile: zsh's completion dump                                      |
| `~/.oh-my-zsh`     | relocated by ZSH only, a shell variable (open question 48)            |
| `~/.gemini`        | no config file relocates it (open question 48)                        |
| `~/.pulumi`        | relocated by PULUMI_HOME only (open question 48)                      |
| `~/.terraform.d`   | no config file relocates it (open question 48)                        |
| `~/.ansible`       | relocated by ANSIBLE_HOME only (open question 48)                     |
| `~/.kube`          | relocated by KUBECONFIG only (open question 48)                       |
| `~/.expo`          | no config file relocates it (open question 48)                        |
| `~/.agents`        | the skills CLI's home, no config file relocates it (open question 48) |
| `~/.cocoapods`     | relocated by CP_HOME_DIR only (open question 48)                      |
| `~/.gradle`        | relocated by GRADLE_USER_HOME only (open question 48)                 |
| `~/.android`       | relocated by ANDROID_USER_HOME only (open question 48)                |
| `~/.ollama`        | relocated by OLLAMA_MODELS only (open question 48)                    |
| `~/.orbstack`      | OrbStack's own home (open question 48)                                |
| `~/.docker`        | relocated by DOCKER_CONFIG only (open question 48)                    |
| `~/.agent-browser` | no config file relocates it (open question 48)                        |
| `~/.hermes`        | no config file relocates it (open question 48)                        |
| `~/.bun`           | while bun's relocation is pending its macOS-VM proof                  |

## Relocations

Written by `station setup` into the tool's own file, never by a shell variable.

| Tool | File   | Key                    | Value                               | Status                                                                                       |
| ---- | ------ | ---------------------- | ----------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| bun  | bunfig | `install.globalDir`    | `~/.local/share/bun/install/global` | pending: the macOS-VM tier proves bun reads the global bunfig (TODO.md "Machine test tiers") |
| bun  | bunfig | `install.globalBinDir` | `~/.local/share/bun/bin`            | pending: the macOS-VM tier proves bun reads the global bunfig (TODO.md "Machine test tiers") |
| bun  | bunfig | `install.cache.dir`    | `~/.cache/bun/install`              | pending: the macOS-VM tier proves bun reads the global bunfig (TODO.md "Machine test tiers") |
| go   | go-env | `GOPATH`               | `~/.local/share/go`                 | written                                                                                      |
| go   | go-env | `GOMODCACHE`           | `~/.cache/go/mod`                   | written                                                                                      |
| node | npmrc  | `cache`                | `~/.cache/npm`                      | written                                                                                      |
